normalized.name: k4d/stg-init
normalized.description: Initialize one continuous-time STG state from a colmap4d or arrayed COLMAP value.
normalized.docs:
`colmap_4d` is one union-typed port. A scalar colmap4d keeps its real
per-image exposure-midpoint timestamps. An arrayed COLMAP input is converted
to one colmap4d model: frame j receives synthetic uniform time j/(N-1), and
all cameras in the frame share it. Both shapes then use the same colmap4d
loader and camera-diverse continuous-time sampler.

Named training parameters override configpath (defaults match the bundled config).
`param_overrides` applies last, parses JSON values or raw strings, and rejects
unknown keys and structural keys loader/time_mode/train_all/start_time.

`duration` remains in the state as the source frame/render/flow resolution;
it does not choose training samples in continuous mode.

resolution.description: Training image downsample divisor; 1 = full resolution. Overrides the config file.

densify_until_iter.description: Iteration at which Gaussian densification stops. Overrides the config file.

densify_grad_threshold.description: Gradient threshold for densification; lower = more points. Overrides the config file.

opthr.description: Opacity pruning threshold. Overrides the config file.

prune_z_min.description: Minimum z for pruning. Overrides the config file.

opacity_reset_interval.description: Iteration interval for opacity reset. Overrides the config file.

percent_dense.description: Percent dense parameter. Overrides the config file.

param_overrides.description: Extra KEY=VALUE overrides, one per line; applied after named parameters. Keys must exist in the loaded config. Structural keys loader/time_mode/train_all/start_time are forbidden.

exec.shell:
set -euo pipefail
OVERRIDES=(
  --set "resolution={{ params.resolution }}"
  --set "densify_until_iter={{ params.densify_until_iter }}"
  --set "densify_grad_threshold={{ params.densify_grad_threshold }}"
  --set "opthr={{ params.opthr }}"
  --set "prune_z_min={{ params.prune_z_min }}"
  --set "opacity_reset_interval={{ params.opacity_reset_interval }}"
  --set "percent_dense={{ params.percent_dense }}"
)
{% for line in (params.get("param_overrides") or "").splitlines() if line.strip() %}
OVERRIDES+=(--set '{{ line.strip() | replace("'", "'\"'\"'") }}')
{% endfor %}
FLOW=()
if [ -n "{{ inputs.get('flow_dir', '') }}" ]; then FLOW+=(--flow-dir "{{ inputs.get('flow_dir', '') }}"); fi
python {{ package_root }}/stg_state.py init-union \
  --colmap-4d "{{ inputs.colmap_4d }}" \
  --supervision "{{ outputs.supervision }}" \
  --state "{{ outputs.initial_state }}" \
  --preview "{{ outputs.preview }}" \
  --scratch "{{ scratch_dir }}" \
  --config "{{ params.configpath }}" \
  "${OVERRIDES[@]}" \
  "${FLOW[@]}"

environment.boundary: 本地能力检查只覆盖已声明且在可探测范围内的项; 通过不代表一定能运行。环境未冻结、未被代码身份覆盖。
